_comment: Provisions and documents whose corpus text is NO LONGER CURRENT. The corpus holds original enacted texts, so a verbatim quote can still be superseded law. An item citing any of these as a controlling authority must ALSO cite the replacing authority, or it is rejected. Add an entry the moment you discover an amendment.

act-3815-art-315.reason: Estafa peso thresholds amended by RA 10951 (2017). Corpus text shows the original 1930 amounts.
